steps.en: Review a historical skill folder, its helpers and license at a fixed ref
steps.zh: 固定版本，审查历史技能目录、助手及许可

steps.en: Select the reviewed source folder and installation destination
steps.zh: 选择审查过的来源目录与安装目标

steps.en: Fetch the selected source and copy a valid skill into a new directory
steps.zh: 获取选定来源，将有效技能复制到新目录

steps.en: Load the skill in a compatible host and supply the real task input
steps.zh: 在兼容宿主加载技能，提供真实任务输入

steps.en: Guide the host through the task procedure and bundled helpers
steps.zh: 指导宿主按任务流程使用配套助手

value.en: Reuse an inspectable historical task procedure without treating the whole catalogue as maintained or uniformly licensed
value.zh: 复用可审查的历史流程，不误认为全仓仍维护或统一授权
